slots.words: Counting how long people your age live, the money lasts as long as you do more than 19 times in 20.
If you live to 93, the money lasts that long in more than 19 of 20 futures we tried.
If the money ran out at 99, you would still have £11,211 a year after tax from the income you get anyway.
If you live to 93, what is typically left then is £969,000 at today's prices. In the best 1 in 10 futures it is £3,968,000 or more.
We tested to 93, the age your plan runs to. About 3 in 10 women your age live longer than that.
We follow each future on to 103, when fewer than 1 in 50 women your age are still alive.
We used the figures for women, who tend to live longer, because the plan does not say.
